DIPLOMA IN
ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING

Study electrical circuits, machines and power systems, with practical experience in installation, measurement and maintenance.

ABOUT THE PROGRAM

Diploma in Electrical Engineering

Published course update: 30 Nov 2022

OverviewEligibilityScope

Overview

Electrical Engineering study concerns electricity, electronics, electrical machines and power systems.

The published BIT curriculum covers electrical fundamentals, installation, circuits, measurement, machines, power stations, protection, maintenance, projects and industrial attachment.

Eligibility

All Nepalese and foreign candidates must meet CTEVT뭩 entrance requirements. Obtain the application form from BIT administration or an authorized centre, and pay the application fee set by CTEVT.

  • General stream: SEE / SLC passed or equivalent.
  • The original BIT guide lists TSLC aggregate marks of 66.66% from IOE and 68.33% from CTEVT.
  • Foreign students: two copies of a domicile certificate or passport.

These requirements are from BIT뭩 published course guide, dated 30 November 2022. Confirm the current intake criteria, entrance notice and documents with admissions before applying.

Scope

Explore technical work and further study in these areas:

  • Power generation and distribution
  • Communication and networking
  • Control systems
  • Electronics
  • Industrial automation
  • Electrical systems in transport
  • Consumer electronics
  • Medical-device systems
  • Research and development
